cohort: The study participants were 304 Zimbabwean mothers, some infected with HIV and some uninfected, whose infants had received oral poliovirus vaccination.
finding: Mothers of vaccinated infants are unlikely to shed OPV, even when they are infected with HIV.
followup_time: 24 weeks after infant oral poliovirus vaccination
cross-section timing: 1 to 24 weeks after infant oral poliovirus vaccination
